title: Parameterize insertEvent() by profileId in streak_state_provider_test.dart instead of duplicating the raw companion insert

evidence.quote: Future<void> insertEvent(UserDatabase db, DateTime timestamp) async {

why: insertEvent() hardcodes the outer profileId constant, so the one test needing a second profile ('does not count events from another profile', line 111) can't reuse it and instead re-spells the same StreakEventsCompanion.insert(...) call inline (lines 113-121). A future change to the companion's required fields now has two call sites in this file to update instead of one, and they can silently drift apart.
recommendation: Add an optional `{int? profileId}` parameter to insertEvent() (defaulting to the outer constant) and use it at line 113 instead of the inline duplicate.
acceptance_criteria: Only one StreakEventsCompanion.insert(...) call site remains in streak_state_provider_test.dart.
